name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: All land-holding farmer families with cultivable land. Certain exclusion categories apply (institutional landholders, income tax payers, constitutional post holders, etc.). Refer to official source for current details.
benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 each, transferred directly to the farmer's bank account. Refer to official source for current rates.
application_method: Apply through local Patwari/Revenue Officer or Common Service Centre (CSC). Self-registration available at pmkisan.gov.in.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas. Loanee farmers enrolled compulsorily; non-loanee farmers can join voluntarily.
benefits: Crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks. Premium share for farmers: up to 2% for Kharif crops, up to 1.5% for Rabi crops, and up to 5% for commercial/horticultural crops. Refer to official source for current premium rates and sum insured.
application_method: Apply through nearest bank branch, CSC, or online at pmfby.gov.in. Deadline is before the sowing season for respective crops.

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: State governments apply for funding; benefits flow to farmers through state agriculture department schemes and project implementations. Refer to official source for current details.
benefits: Grants to states for agricultural development, infrastructure, and farmer welfare programmes. Specific benefits vary by state scheme. Refer to official source for current details.
application_method: Contact State Agriculture Department or visit rkvy.nic.in for state-level programme details.

name: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers aged 18-40 years with cultivable land up to 2 hectares. Entry age determines monthly premium contribution.
benefits: Minimum assured pension of Rs. 3,000 per month after age 60. Refer to official source for current contribution tables and benefit details.
application_method: Enrol at nearest CSC with Aadhaar card and bank account details.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / NABARD, Government of India
eligibility: Farmers, sharecroppers, oral lessees, tenant farmers, and self-help groups engaged in agriculture and allied activities. Refer to official source for current details.
benefits: Short-term revolving credit for crop production, post-harvest expenses, and allied activities at concessional interest rates. Interest subvention available. Refer to official source for current interest rates and credit limits.
application_method: Apply at nearest nationalised bank, cooperative bank, or regional rural bank. Submit land records and identity documents.

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: Farmers in identified districts growing rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals, or oilseeds. Specific eligibility determined by state agriculture departments.
benefits: Subsidies on seeds, farm machinery, plant protection, soil amendments, and resource conservation technologies. Refer to official source for current subsidy rates.
application_method: Apply through local Agriculture Department office or block-level agriculture officer.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming practices and form clusters of 50 farmers per cluster of 50 acres. Refer to official source for current details.
benefits: Financial assistance for organic farming transition, certification, and marketing. Rs. 50,000 per hectare over 3 years (subject to revision). Refer to official source for current rates.
application_method: Apply through state agriculture department. Farmers must form cluster groups.

name: e-National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / Small Farmers Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC)
eligibility: All farmers whose produce is registered at participating APMC mandis. Traders and FPOs also eligible to participate.
benefits: Online transparent price discovery, seamless inter-market trade, better price realisation for farmers, reduced transaction costs.
application_method: Register at enam.gov.in or through the local APMC mandi. Aadhaar and bank account required.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: All farmers. Soil health cards issued once every two years per farm holding.
benefits: Free soil testing and a Soil Health Card with crop-wise nutrient recommendations to reduce input costs and improve yields.
application_method: Contact local agriculture department or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) for soil sample collection. Check soilhealth.dac.gov.in.

name: Karnataka Rajya Raitha Suraksha Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
authority: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
eligibility: Karnataka farmers growing notified crops in notified areas. Loanee farmers enrolled through banks; non-loanee farmers can enrol voluntarily. Refer to official source for current details.
benefits: Crop insurance coverage under PMFBY implemented by Karnataka state. State government covers a portion of premium. Refer to official source for current premium sharing and indemnity details.
application_method: Apply through nearest bank or CSC, or contact District Agriculture Officer in Karnataka.

name: Kerala Karshaka Kshemanidhi
authority: Kerala Agricultural Workers Welfare Board / Department of Agriculture, Government of Kerala
eligibility: Farmers and agricultural workers registered with the Kerala Agricultural Workers Welfare Board. Refer to official source for current enrollment criteria and age limits.
benefits: Social security and pension benefits for registered farmers and agricultural workers. Refer to official source for current pension amounts and welfare benefits.
application_method: Register through Kerala Agricultural Workers Welfare Board or local Krishi Bhavan.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, agri-entrepreneurs, and start-ups for post-harvest management and community farming assets. Refer to official source for current details.
benefits: Medium-long term debt financing with 3% interest subvention per annum and credit guarantee support for eligible projects. Refer to official source for current rates and limits.
application_method: Apply online at agriinfra.dac.gov.in or through participating banks and financial institutions.

name: YSR Rythu Bharosa
authority: Department of Agriculture and Cooperation, Government of Andhra Pradesh
eligibility: All farmer families owning cultivable land in Andhra Pradesh, including tenant farmers. Refer to official source for current eligibility criteria and exclusions.
benefits: Investment support of Rs. 13,500 per year per farmer family (includes central PM-KISAN component and state top-up), paid in two instalments. Refer to official source for current amounts.
application_method: Farmers are enrolled through village-level revenue records. Contact local Village Revenue Officer (VRO) or Agriculture Extension Officer, or visit ap.gov.in for details.

name: Andhra Pradesh Comprehensive Crop Insurance Scheme
authority: Department of Agriculture and Cooperation, Government of Andhra Pradesh
eligibility: Farmers cultivating notified crops in Andhra Pradesh. Loanee farmers enrolled through banks; non-loanee farmers may enrol voluntarily. Refer to official source for current details.
benefits: State-level implementation of crop insurance providing financial support against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases. Refer to official source for current premium rates and indemnity levels.
application_method: Apply through nearest bank branch, Common Service Centre, or contact District Agriculture Officer in Andhra Pradesh.

name: Uzhavar Sandhai (Farmers Market Scheme)
authority: Department of Agricultural Marketing, Government of Tamil Nadu
eligibility: Farmers in Tamil Nadu who wish to sell their produce directly to consumers without intermediaries. Registration with local agriculture office required.
benefits: Direct market access for farmers through dedicated Uzhavar Sandhai outlets, eliminating middlemen and ensuring better price realisation. Farmers retain full sale proceeds.
application_method: Register with local Agriculture Department or contact District Agricultural Marketing Officer in Tamil Nadu. Visit tn.gov.in for scheme details.

name: Tamil Nadu Crop Insurance Scheme (TNCIS)
authority: Department of Agriculture, Government of Tamil Nadu
eligibility: All farmers in Tamil Nadu growing notified crops. Small and marginal farmers receive additional premium subsidy. Refer to official source for current details.
benefits: Financial compensation for crop loss due to drought, flood, pest attack, and other natural calamities. State government subsidises a portion of the premium for small and marginal farmers. Refer to official source for current rates.
application_method: Apply through the Village Agriculture Assistant (VAA) or nearest Primary Agricultural Cooperative Credit Society (PACCS). Contact District Agriculture Office for details.

name: Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Vima Yojana
authority: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
eligibility: Farmers aged 10 to 75 years registered in Maharashtra land records. Covers accidental death or permanent disability. Refer to official source for current eligibility.
benefits: Accidental insurance cover of Rs. 2,00,000 in case of accidental death or permanent total disability. Partial disability covered at Rs. 1,00,000. Refer to official source for current amounts.
application_method: Premium is paid by the state government on behalf of farmers. In case of claim, apply through District Superintendent of Agriculture. Visit mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in for details.

name: Jalyukt Shivar Abhiyan
authority: Water Conservation Department, Government of Maharashtra
eligibility: Farmers in drought-prone villages of Maharashtra. Village selection is made by the state government based on water scarcity. Refer to official source for current details.
benefits: Water conservation infrastructure such as farm ponds, bunding, check dams, and stream deepening to make villages water-neutral and improve irrigation availability for farmers.
application_method: Beneficiary villages are identified by the state government. Contact local Panchayat or District Collector's office for village-level implementation details.

name: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: Farmers growing notified oilseed, pulses, and copra crops in states/districts that opt to implement the scheme component. Refer to official source for current notified crops and states.
benefits: Price support to farmers to protect against distress sale below Minimum Support Price (MSP) through three components: Price Support Scheme (PSS), Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS), and Pilot Private Procurement and Stockist Scheme (PPPS). Refer to official source for current details.
application_method: Procurement is conducted by state-designated agencies when market prices fall below MSP. Register with local Agriculture Department or cooperative society for enrolment.
